scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('main a[href]').each((i,e)=>{const x=$(e);const u=x.attr('href');if(u && /^\/(tech|travel|life|camp|gallery)\/[^/]+\//.test(u))posts.push({url:u,title:x.find('h2,h3').first().text().trim(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published').first().text().trim()||null});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const root=$("article .prose").first().clone();root.find('script,style,nav,form,.post-comments,.comments,.upvote-button,.toast,.post-footer,.post-meta,.blog-tags').remove();return {title:$("h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:root.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('.byline .author,.author-name').first().text().trim()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 首頁分類文章卡片同站兩層路徑，正文已實讀 article .prose。
